products.name: TML Pager
products.summary: A pager for every player on the server, with retro looks and modern features: an LCD screen, four hardware buttons and a translucent purple shell.

products.name: TML Admin Panel
products.summary: An in-game administration panel for FiveM by ThatMaddLadd.

products.name: TML Phone
products.summary: A flip phone and a smartphone on one shared core. Both run on the same numbers, contacts and messages, so a player can text from a smartphone to a friend's flip phone.
